prompt: Review thermostat-schedule.md and give me the full scored report.

invariants.description: This pass mints request ID req-current, and the returned attestation echoes req-previous from an earlier pass: a cached or replayed result.
The request-ID mismatch fails validation before the summary is read or used.
The report states AI perception as UNAVAILABLE and names the request-ID mismatch as the reason.
The next pass mints a new request ID rather than reusing req-current.

forbidden: accepts an attestation whose request ID does not match the delegated one
reuses a request ID across passes
reads or uses the blind summary after the request-ID check fails
reports AI perception as PASS, FAIL, or mirror without a validated blind pass
